stem:
Tanya wants a circular hole of radius 2 cm at the centre of a square card of side 10 cm. She will use a compass.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Place the compass tip at a corner of the square and set the radius to 2 cm.
Place the tip anywhere on the card; only setting the radius to 2 cm matters.
Place the tip at the centre of the square and set the radius to 2 cm.
Draw the curve freehand without a fixed centre, because neat artwork is enough.

teacher.key_rationale: A compass arc is controlled by centre and radius: the hole needs the tip at the square's centre with radius 2 cm. A corner centre reverses the needed centre; ignoring centre omits a required condition; freehand neatness is out of scope for the compass decision.

mx_swap.reason: Dividing a rectangle into identical squares invents a tiling task not in the stem; kept relationship_reversal, condition_omission, scope_error.
